agents.name: Dockerfile Cache Optimization
agents.summary: Restructures Dockerfiles for BuildKit layer caching without changing what the image installs, runs, or exposes. A downstream Run step commits and opens the PR.
agents.description: Forked from the Harness dockerfileCacheOptimizer template with MCP connectors optional. The agent only edits Dockerfiles and .dockerignore. Git, branch, and PR work happen in the pipeline Run step. No MCP is required for the happy path.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: Anthropic or Bedrock connector the agent calls for model access.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: A model your LLM connector can serve, such as a Claude model id or Bedrock inference profile ARN.

configuration.label: MCP connector
configuration.note: This fork makes MCP optional. The agent edits files on disk and needs no MCP server.

configuration.label: Git connector with write access
configuration.note: The pipeline clones the repo and pushes the fix branch. The agent itself never runs git.

prerequisites: Git connector with write access to the repo

agents.name: Documentation Generator
agents.summary: Reads a cloned codebase and writes generated Markdown documentation under docs/, including README-style overview, APIs, and usage.
agents.description: A technical documentation agent. It discovers structure with Glob, reads entry points, greps public interfaces, and writes generated files marked so later runs can overwrite them without touching hand-written docs.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: Anthropic or Bedrock connector the agent calls for model access.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: A model your LLM connector can serve.

configuration.label: MCP connector
configuration.note: The agent reads the cloned repo and writes files locally. No MCP server required.

configuration.label: Git connector with write access
configuration.note: Only needed if you commit the generated docs/ back to the repo.

prerequisites: Git connector with write access if you commit docs

agents.name: Test Results Summarizer
agents.summary: Turns raw test logs into a concise PASS/FAIL summary with failure list, coverage callouts, and an optional PR comment.
agents.description: Runs after a test step. Reads the test output file, reports totals and failures, and can post or update a PR comment. Designed around go test output but useful anywhere the log is parseable.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: Anthropic or Bedrock connector the agent calls for model access.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: A model your LLM connector can serve.

configuration.label: Test output file
configuration.note: A prior Run step must write test output to this path, plus an exit code output variable.

configuration.label: SCM MCP connector
configuration.note: Only needed to post or update the summary as a pull request comment.

configuration.label: SCM token secret
configuration.note: Paired with the SCM MCP connector for PR comments. Replace YOUR_SCM_TOKEN_SECRET with your secret id.

prerequisites: Test output file from a prior Run step
Optional SCM MCP for PR comments

agents.name: Unit Test Verification
agents.summary: Maps meaningful unit tests to repository services and components, checks a configurable structural coverage threshold, and interrupts the pipeline through Harness MCP when it fails.
agents.description: Analyzes a cloned repository to calculate the percentage of independently testable services and components with meaningful unit tests. It reports its evidence and can use Harness MCP to interrupt the current execution when coverage is below the configured threshold.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: An account, org, or project AI connector available to this project.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: A model identifier supported by the selected LLM connector.

configuration.label: Harness MCP connector
configuration.note: Must expose the Harness pipeline execution interrupt or abort operation.

configuration.label: Cloned repository
configuration.note: The CI stage must clone the repository into /harness before the agent runs.

configuration.label: Coverage threshold
configuration.note: The percentage of testable services/components that must have meaningful unit tests; defaults to 90.

prerequisites: Harness MCP connector with permission to interrupt pipeline executions

agents.name: Docker Image Tag Inspector
agents.summary: Inspects every tag in a public Docker Hub repository, identifies tags older than a configurable threshold, and recommends cleanup candidates.
agents.description: Queries and paginates the public Docker Hub tags API, calculates exact tag ages, groups stale tags, and reports conservative cleanup and storage recommendations without deleting anything.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: An account, org, or project AI connector available to this project.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: A model identifier supported by the selected LLM connector.

configuration.label: Docker Hub repository
configuration.note: A public repository in namespace/name format.

configuration.label: Tag age threshold
configuration.note: Tags older than this many days are reported; defaults to 30.

configuration.label: Docker connector
configuration.note: The inspector uses Docker Hub's public API. Passing a connector identifier alone does not authenticate curl requests.

agents.name: Docker Tag Governance Agent
agents.summary: Evaluates Docker Hub tag retention rules, estimates storage costs, supports approval-gated cleanup, and protects designated release tags.
agents.description: Audits one or more Docker Hub repositories using protected patterns, retain-count, and age rules. It is report-only by default and requires a Docker Hub username and token secret before performing deletions.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: An account, org, or project AI connector available to this project.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: A model identifier supported by the selected LLM connector.

configuration.label: Docker Hub repositories
configuration.note: One or more namespace/name repositories, separated by commas.

configuration.label: Retention policy values
configuration.note: Report-only is the safe default. Set the retain count, protected patterns, and age threshold explicitly.

configuration.label: Docker Hub username
configuration.note: Required when cleanupMode causes deletion; not needed for public report-only runs.

configuration.label: Docker Hub token
configuration.note: Required for deletion. Supply a Harness secret containing a scoped Docker Hub access token.

configuration.label: Docker connector
configuration.note: A connector identifier does not make credentials available to curl. Cleanup uses the explicit secret input instead.

prerequisites: Docker Hub username and token secret for cleanup modes

pipelines.name: Dockerfile Cache Optimizer
pipelines.summary: Clone a repo, run the Dockerfile cache agent, then commit Dockerfile and .dockerignore changes and push a branch.

pipelines.name: Documentation Generator
pipelines.summary: Clone a repo, generate docs/ with the documentation agent, then commit and push a docs branch.

pipelines.name: Test Results Summarizer
pipelines.summary: Run your test command, ignore a failing test step, then summarize results with the test summarizer agent.

pipelines.name: Unit Test Verification
pipelines.summary: Clone a repository, map services and components to meaningful unit tests, and interrupt the current execution through Harness MCP when structural coverage is below the threshold.
prerequisites: Harness MCP connector with pipeline execution interrupt permission

configuration.label: Repository and build
configuration.note: Choose the repository and branch or pull request Harness CI should clone.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: Set this to an accessible account, org, or project AI connector reference.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: Use a model supported by the selected LLM connector.

configuration.label: Harness MCP connector
configuration.note: Must allow the agent to find and invoke the current execution's interrupt operation.

configuration.label: Coverage threshold
configuration.note: Defaults to 90 percent structural service/component unit-test coverage.

pipelines.name: Docker Image Tag Inspector
pipelines.summary: Inspect all tags in a public Docker Hub repository and report tags older than a configurable age without modifying the registry.

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: Set this to an accessible account, org, or project AI connector reference.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: Use a model supported by the selected LLM connector.

configuration.label: Docker Hub repository
configuration.note: Enter a public repository in namespace/name format.

configuration.label: Tag age threshold
configuration.note: Defaults to 30 days.

pipelines.name: Docker Tag Governance
pipelines.summary: Analyze Docker Hub tag retention, optionally collect approval, and run guarded cleanup with explicit Docker Hub credentials.
prerequisites: Docker Hub username and Harness token secret for cleanup
At least one authorized approval user

configuration.label: LLM connector
configuration.note: Set this to an accessible account, org, or project AI connector reference.

configuration.label: Model id
configuration.note: Use a model supported by the selected LLM connector.

configuration.label: Docker Hub repositories
configuration.note: Enter comma-separated repositories in namespace/name format.

configuration.label: Retention policy values
configuration.note: The default mode is report-only. Review every protected pattern before enabling deletion.

configuration.label: Docker Hub username
configuration.note: Required when cleanupMode triggers deletion.

configuration.label: Docker Hub token
configuration.note: Required when cleanupMode triggers deletion. Provide a scoped token stored as a Harness secret.

configuration.label: Approval group
configuration.note: The sample uses account._account_all_users. Replace it with a narrower authorized user group for production.
